title: Microsoft Entra ID: extended 30-day backup and recovery through Microsoft 365 Backup
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents the 30-day Premium plan in preview, including enablement, administrator roles, licensing and consumption pricing. The briefing still reports these as unpublished and understates direct cost; its existing recovery paths and Graph calls are supported.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes extended Entra object backup and recovery through Microsoft 365 Backup.
claims.quote: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs.

claims.claim: The meter for the 30-day extension is not yet published.

claims.claim: No switch, setting or enablement procedure for the 30-day extension is documented on either surface.
claims.quote: Select Settings. Select Microsoft 365 Backup from the list of products. On the Microsoft 365 Backup page, in the Entra section, select Set up policy.
claims.fix: Replace the existing row's UI null with surface 'Microsoft 365 admin center' and path 'Settings > Microsoft 365 Backup > Entra > Set up policy > Overview > Policy Settings > Review Entra backup policy > Create policy', with docs https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/backup/backup-view-edit-policies. Replace its note with 'Premium (preview) is off by default; configure billing and create the Entra policy to enable it. The backup recovery window is fixed at 30 days.' Leave the API null; no Premium-specific enablement API was found in the targeted search.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not describe the 30-day extension in November 2026.

claims.fix: Replace the sentence with: 'The roadmap still lists In development with a December CY2026 General Availability target, while Microsoft Learn now documents the 30-day Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Premium plan in preview.'

claims.claim: No user or application can turn off, delete or modify the tenant's Entra backups, so governance is access to restore rather than enablement.
